nodes.label: Poultry Fecal Disease Data Collection App Screenshots
nodes.description: Three-panel figure documenting the collection protocol for a poultry fecal disease dataset. Left and right panels are mobile UI screenshots of an ODK/Android-style form titled 'Poultry Fec...' with a save icon and overflow menu; the left screen offers 'Take Picture' / 'Choose Image' buttons for a Fecal Image and a single-select 'Type of Image' radio group (Healthy, Coccidiosis, Newcastle, Salmonella, Other); the right screen continues the same radio group and adds a free-text 'Observations on Image' field and a 'GPS Reading' section with a 'Start GeoPoint' button. The centre panel is a field photograph of a data collector bending over to photograph droppings on a blue tarpaulin with free-range chickens around them.
nodes.rationale: Capture is done in-situ on a phone with a mandatory single-select label and an attached GPS geopoint so that each image is labelled at the moment of collection by the field worker rather than post-hoc, and so samples are geographically traceable for outbreak mapping.

nodes.label: Mobile Labelled-Capture Form Pattern
nodes.description: UI pattern: image acquisition control (camera or gallery) immediately followed by a constrained class picker, a free-text observation field and an automatic GPS reading, all in one saveable form.
nodes.rationale: A closed radio-button vocabulary prevents label drift across many field collectors, while the free-text field preserves nuance the fixed classes would otherwise discard; keeping label and image in one atomic record avoids the mismatch that arises when photos and spreadsheets are reconciled later.

nodes.label: Poultry Disease Class Taxonomy (Healthy, Coccidiosis, Newcastle, Salmonella, Other)
nodes.description: The five-way label set applied to each fecal image: Healthy, Coccidiosis, Newcastle, Salmonella, Other.
nodes.rationale: An explicit 'Other' bucket is included so collectors are never forced to mislabel an unfamiliar presentation into one of the four known classes.
